question: Haugz-i-Sultani was constructed by ________
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iltutmish.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Haugz-i-Sultani **was constructed by **Iltutmish**, who was the** third ruler** of the** Delhi Sultanate.**
 
• Iltutmish was known for his** military campaigns** and **administrative reforms**, which helped strengthen the Sultanate
 
• The construction of Haugz-i-Sultani, also known as the** Sultanate's administrative headquarters**, was an important symbol of Iltutmish's power and authority.
 
• The building was also significant for its architectural style, which blended** Islamic and Indian elements.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Informatio__**

 
• **Sikandar Lodi **was a later ruler of the **Delhi Sultanate** who is known for his patronage of the **arts and literature.**
 
• **Babur **was the founder of the **Mughal Empire** and is known for his **military conquests **and cultural achievements.
 
• **Akbar** was a l**ater Mughal emperor **who is known for his** religious tolerance and administrative reforms.**
